silhouette.reason: Bust with long blond hair and a green tunic; the hair hangs as separate stringy strands rather than a mass, and the elf ear tips do not break the outline in any view, so it reads as a human woman.
fixes: more hair volume over the crown and denser, wider locks (hair.ts) so the hair reads as a mass
part the hair behind the ears so the long ear tips break the outline at 3/4 and FRONT

proportions.reason: Face is doll-like: mid-face long, eyes small and set high, neck thin against broad puffed shoulders.
fixes: shorten the mid-face 3% and enlarge the eyes slightly (spec.ts)
slimmer, less puffed shoulders on the tunic (torso.ts)

materials.reason: The tunic is a blotchy green with grey smears, not cloth; skin is flat pink with rouge circles; the gold trim and clasp read as metal.
fixes: a silk/wool strip for tunic and cloak with even colour and soft sheen, no grey blotches
skin strip with subsurface-like warmth instead of rouge circles

detail.reason: Clasp, gold trim and collar exist, but the face lacks lid/lip definition and the hair has no strand grooves over the crown.
fixes: strand grooves over the crown; defined lids and lip line

wear.reason: Grey smears on the tunic could be dust, but they read as texture noise; no fray, no soiled hems.
fixes: dust on the cloak shoulders and fray at the hems as authored, not noise

lod.reason: LOD2 now keeps blond hair cards in the LOD0 colour, but they become blocky slabs and the face is faceted with dark eye holes.
fixes: thinner, more numerous LOD2 hair cards and smoothed face colour

technical.reason: QA clean; 71k / 19k / 3k triangles over 5 draws; many strand cards spent where they read as noise.
fixes: fewer, wider hair cards at LOD0 and drop hidden scalp under the hair
